title: E-commerce demo: autocomplete=off not set
body: **Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?** Bug. **Bug: What is the current behavior?** The instant-search searchbox displays the native suggestions dropdown menu. **Bug: What is the expected behavior?** It should not, adding `autocomplete="off"` to the input. Tested on https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/examples/e-commerce-infinite/
